newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Karaoke bar blaze kills 15 in HK, arson suspected.
newsitem.headline: Karaoke bar blaze kills 15 in HK, arson suspected.

text.p: A fire believed to have been set by arsonists swept through a karaoke bar in a Hong Kong nightlife district on Saturday, killing at least 15 people, police said.
A police spokesman said arson was suspected because the blaze had started on a staircase and spread rapidly.
Hong Kong radio said 13 people were in hospital after the fire in the bar in the Tsimshatsui district on the Kowloon Peninsula.
The blaze broke out on the first floor of the bar on Pratt Avenue around 4 a.m. Firefighters managed to extinguish it within an hour and a half, Hong Kong radio said.
The dead included five men and 10 women. Survivors fled the building down firefighter's ladders as the blaze raced from the first floor to the second and third storeys.

It was the second major fire tragedy in Hong Kong in as many months. In late November 40 people were killed in Hong Kong's worst building blaze on record when fire gutted a commercial block in Kowloon's "golden mile" Nathan Road shopping district.
